artworks.title: Woman in Bed, Profile (Femme au lit, profil)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a bedroom setting. One person is seated on the bed with long, straight hair, looking to the right. The other person is standing next to the bed with short, curly hair, slightly leaning forward. Both individuals wear loose, flowing garments. The background has swirling, golden strokes, and the bed's headboard is visible.

artworks.title: At the Renaissance: Sarah Bernhardt in "Phedre" (A la Renaissance: Sarah Bernhardt dans "Phèdre")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image features two figures from the waist up. The person on the left is slightly turned upwards, partially looking sideways. They wear a shawl or veil and a dress with a circular pattern around their waist. The figure on the right is seated or crouched, looking up at the other person. They have a dark robe and their hands rest on the other person's arm. The background has light and dark areas, hinting at an indoor setting, with a shadowed section on the right side.

artworks.title: Ducarre at the Ambassadeurs (Ducarre aux ambassadeurs)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two men seated from the waist up. One man is facing slightly left, while the other is facing forward. The first man has a bald head and a beard, wearing a coat. The second man has distinctive facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored shirt. They are both holding glasses at a small round table. The background has a simple textured pattern.

artworks.title: American Singer (Chanteur américain)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract figure dressed in a patterned outfit. The figure is depicted with a checkered jacket and trousers, and a bent posture. The drawing uses bold, black lines against a cream background to outline the figure's form and clothing. An element in the image appears to emanate from the head area. The overall style suggests a loose, quick sketch, capturing the essence of the subject with minimal detail but with a strong emphasis on the pattern and posture. It's a dynamic composition aiming to convey mood or character through clothing and gesture.

artworks.title: A Spectator (Une spectatrice)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a woman seated upright, with her head slightly turned to the right. Her facial features include defined eyebrows and a sharp nose. She has neatly styled hair in a low bun and wears a dark hat and outfit. The attire includes a high collar. In the background, there are two figures, one seated and apparently male, wearing a hat. The other figure appears to be sketching or looking down. The background consists of abstract patterns with vertical lines and shaded textures. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic style, using ink or charcoal.

artworks.title: Drunkard (Soularde)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's profile, showcasing their face and neck. The person's profile is detailed from the forehead to the chin, including a notable nose and a slightly open mouth. The hair is depicted as voluminous with flowing lines, suggesting a short or styled look. The sketch focuses on the facial contours rather than detailed features. The background is simple, with some lines and a small cross-hatched square possibly representing objects or textures. The drawing is on speckled paper, adding to its vintage appearance.

artworks.title: To Menilmontant from Bruant (A Ménilmontant, de Bruant)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper-body figure, featuring a profile view of the head, neck, and shoulders. The person is looking upward with closed eyes, mouth sketched minimally. The hair is styled back, possibly tied up. Abstract lines around the shoulders suggest fabric or drapery. The background is a blank canvas with abstract strokes of vertical and horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Bowing to the Audience (Saluant le public)
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a woman from the waist up, seated on a sofa or chair. She is leaning back slightly, with her head tilted to one side and resting in a relaxed manner. The woman's facial features are outlined, with a hint of a smile, and her hair is styled in an updo with soft waves. She appears to be wearing a gown with large puffy sleeves. Around her, there are forms suggesting cushions or fabric, creating a sense of comfort and softness. There is no visible jewelry or distinct objects. The background consists of light sketch marks indicating a draped fabric or curtain, creating a sense of enclosure and privacy.

artworks.title: In "La glu" (Dans "La glu")
artworks.description: The image captures the upper half of a person's body in a slightly angled pose. The sketch focuses on the face, shoulders, and hint of clothing. The facial features are delicately outlined, displaying a subtle expression with eyes, nose, and mouth. Hair is short and wavy. The background consists of abstract lines and shading.

artworks.title: Pessima
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person's face in profile. The face and part of the neck are visible, with the person facing towards the right side of the image. The facial features are lightly sketched, including a nose and a slight smile. The hair is loosely drawn above the head. The person is not wearing distinguishable clothing, jewelry, or holding any objects. Beside the person, there is an abstract geometric shape resembling a simplified figure in a walking pose. The background is a plain, light tan color.

artworks.title: Old Song (Chanson ancienne)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person shown from the upper body upwards. The person is sitting or reclining, with their head tilted back slightly and resting against a surface. The facial features are softly sketched with closed eyes and a relaxed mouth, framed by curly hair. The clothing suggests loose, flowing fabric with a high collar or ruffles, and there is a dark bow or ribbon near the neck. The person appears to be wearing a bracelet on their wrist. The background consists of sketchy lines and shading, without depicting any specific setting.

artworks.title: Woman at the Tub (Femme au tub)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman bent over, pouring liquid from a pitcher into a basin. Her upper body is exposed, with her head turned slightly to the left. Her hair is long and tied back, falling over her shoulder. She is wearing a long-sleeved gown that reaches her ankles. In the background, there is a fireplace on the left with a bust and a circular frame on the wall above. Above her, there is a wall with faint decorative drawings and patterns. The floor has a red rug, with a white shape partially visible in the bottom right corner. The color palette is muted and pale, with red and yellow accents.

artworks.title: Paula Brébion
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image presents an outline drawing of the upper half of a person's body in a side profile. The person is in a relaxed stance with their right arm bent and raised towards their face. Facial features are shown with simple lines, including a nose, lips, and a closed eye. The hair is styled in an updo with a small curl at the forehead. The person is wearing a low-neckline garment with short puff sleeves, but additional details are minimal. The background is plain and unadorned. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image beyond the figure's silhouette.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated. The person on the left appears to be reading, with an open book in front of them. They have wavy hair and delicate features, wearing a long garment. The person on the right, likely an angel, faces the left figure with one hand raised and holding a staff. They have curly hair and wear a detailed robe, with wings visible. The background shows a domestic setting with a curtain, a shelf with books, a flask, and a mirror or decorative element with light or a dove emanating from it. In the upper right, an architectural scene with distant buildings and cloudy shapes is depicted, where cherubic figures can be seen.

artworks.title: Le Duc de Guise, Roy Ameriquain
artworks.description: The image shows a regal figure seated on a horse. The figure is in profile view facing left with focused facial features, long wavy hair flowing from under an elaborate helmet, and intricate armor. The horse is adorned with decorative trappings matching the rider's aesthetic. The rider holds a lance, and above them is a blank banner with ribbons and foliage. The background is simple, emphasizing the figure and horse.

artworks.title: Cheval de Main et Palfreniers Romains
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse and a figure in a theatrical or ceremonial setting. The horse is adorned with elaborate decorations and the figure appears to be orchestrating the horse's performance. A ribbon-like structure above them adds a whimsical touch to the composition. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Baroque art, with detailed and dramatic expression.

artworks.title: The Mermaid and the Monkey
Hunters at the Edge of the Woods
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and black wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a horizon line about halfway up the composition. Distant trees and clouds are visible in the sky. Two figures are walking along a path with a small dog near some trees. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, resembling a pencil or ink drawing. The color palette is subdued, with soft grays and sepia tones. In the background, the landscape transitions into a densely wooded area, while the foreground has sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child Accompanied by Saints
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four figures in a tight arrangement, displaying their upper bodies. The central figure is a seated woman holding a young child on her lap. The child reaches towards another smaller child, who is reaching out to the central figure. To the left, a figure wearing a headscarf is holding a flower. On the right, an older male figure with a short beard is looking towards the woman and child and holding a slender instrument. The figures are dressed in draped garments and the background shows a simple interior space with a small window or opening in the top right corner, letting in light, and an inscription in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Lithographer
artworks.description: This is a detailed painting of a lithographer's workshop. The scene showcases different stages of the lithographic printing process. On the left, an individual is preparing a stone slab for printing with tools nearby. In the center, an artist is drawing on a stone slab, surrounded by images and samples on the wall. On the right, another figure is operating a printing press. The colors, lighting, and detailing create a vivid representation of the workshop. The space is well-lit with natural light coming through large windows. The painting is in the style of L. Prang & Co.

artworks.title: Thirty Archers and Pages
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mounted figures in elaborate attire. The drawing depicts a procession of mounted riders, each on horseback, dressed in ornate clothing with plumes and embellishments. The composition of the image shows the riders closely clustered, with various poses suggesting motion and energy among the group. The horses, depicted from behind and in profile, are adorned with decorative accoutrements. The overall arrangement and fine detailing of the etching emphasize the pomp and ceremony of the cavalcade.

artworks.title: Twenty Pages and Five Turkish Horses
artworks.description: This drawing shows a group of mounted figures in formation. The procession includes figures on horseback, each wearing feathered headdresses. The horses display different gaits, creating a sense of movement. The figures are dressed in detailed clothing, possibly ceremonial or formal attire. The background is simple to emphasize the figures and horses. Thin, uniform lines are used throughout the composition. The drawing is labeled with an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Master of His Excellency's Stables and Twenty Servants
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession featuring horses and elaborately dressed figures. The scene shows a long line of horses with figures either mounted on them or walking alongside. The figures are in ornamental attire. The drawing is detailed, capturing the movement and positioning of the animals and figures, and includes textual elements at the bottom. The style of the drawing is consistent with works depicting historical or ceremonial events with a focus on detailed line work and composition.

artworks.title: Spanish Gentlemen, Polish and French Horsemen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mounted figures and others on foot gathered under a large tree. The scene depicts a multitude of figures, both on horseback and walking, gathered beneath the arching branches of a prominent tree. The tree's trunk divides the assembly into two groups. The figures appear to be finely dressed. The figures’ postures and the horses’ positions suggest a moment of interaction. There is a historic setting, with the attire indicating a period from the past. The use of line and shadow adds depth to the drawing, emphasizing the texture of the tree and the details of the clothing worn by the figures.
